about: Chapter one's map. The player sees the room they're in, its exits, and a pixel map of the rooms any host has been in. at = where the room is drawn on that map (grid cell; scripts/layout-maps.ts fills in missing ones). threat = the fight in the room; enemy = who holds it (regular rooms only; elites and bosses come from their threat) (the chapter's two bosses: threat 5, and the King on 10, its last room). goal = one of the chapter's three hidden goals, found by looking. requires 'goals' = sealed until all three are found. Keep room text to about two sentences. arena = the fight's board, drawn as text rows: '.' deck, '~' open water, '#' crates, 'd' drums, 'n' nets, 'p' pumps, '?' a loose crate (there half the time), 'f' fuel fire, 'c' live cable, 'b' chemical bilge, 'h' split decking, 'P' your start, 'E' enemy starts (first is the lead).
title: Chapter one: the Indian Ocean
ending: The King slumps among other people's parts, and the grafts let go of him one at a time. Out past the rafts a horn sounds, and the sea is open.

rooms.name: The body dock
rooms.text: Bodies hang in racks under a tarp, tagged at the ankle and swaying with the sea. One of them is looking out through your eyes.

exits.hint: voices, and the creak of plastic

rooms.name: Bleached deck
rooms.text: Crate plates lashed edge to edge, sun-white and sticky with salt. Someone has scratched tally marks into every one.

look.text: A tally scratched into the plastic, counting to something nobody finished.

rooms.name: Bottle field
rooms.text: Ten thousand bottles netted into a floor that shifts under every step. Some still have messages in them.

look.text: One note, the ink run: 'If you find this I am already sold.'

rooms.name: Rope walkway
rooms.text: A walkway of drums and rope over open water. The ropes are newer than anything else here.

look.text: Rope knotted the way sailors do it. Whoever tied it knew the old ways, and is gone.

rooms.name: Tarp shacks
rooms.text: Shacks of blue tarp and bottle walls, doors tied shut from the outside. A pot is still warm on a stove.

look.text: A child's drawing pinned to a door: a man lying down, and a little light at the back of his neck.

rooms.name: Grey Lane stall
rooms.text: A lantern-lit stall selling parts from a cool box, no questions asked. The seller doesn't look up when you arrive.

rooms.name: Pump-fleet hull
rooms.text: The upturned hull of a fishing boat, its belly painted with a woman's face. Pumps beat inside it like a slow heart.

look.text: Under the painted face, someone has scratched a smaller one. It has your jaw.

rooms.name: The bilge
rooms.text: Knee-deep runoff under the raft, glowing faintly green. Something has been dragged through it recently.

look.text: A shoe, still laced, with nothing in it. The water has rinsed it very clean.

rooms.name: Pump room
rooms.text: Hand pumps in rows, each worked by someone with a pump of their own in their chest. They keep time without looking at each other.

rooms.name: Cartel weigh-station
rooms.text: A crane scale hung over the water with hooks on the end. Everything that comes through here is weighed, including people.

look.text: The ledger by the scale lists weights, not names. One line is crossed out and rewritten: yours.

rooms.server: Under the scale's counterweight, a server humming in a nest of cable. Someone has scratched a tally down its side and never finished it.
rooms.quiet: The scale hangs still over the water, its hooks empty. Nobody comes to be weighed any more.

rooms.name: Floating lanes
rooms.text: Canals between rafts, crowded with boats made of fridges and doors. Everyone moves aside for you, then stares.

exits.hint: humming, and the smell of ozone

look.text: A boat made from a fridge door, with a child's sticker still on it.

rooms.name: Surgery barge
rooms.text: A white barge, scrubbed clean, with a row of steel slabs under bright lamps. It is the only quiet place on the water.

look.text: One slab has restraints, and an outline in dried fluid that fits you exactly.

rooms.name: Cable garden
rooms.text: Stolen power lines strung overhead like vines, sparking where they touch the water. Lights burn here day and night.

look.text: Every cable is labelled with whoever stole it. The labels go back forty years.

rooms.name: Net lofts
rooms.text: Nets hung in layers like curtains, heavy with plastic and the odd bone. Floats knock together in the wind.

exits.hint: steps, and a crowd going quiet

look.text: A manifest line, stamped and signed: 'Unit 4471. Donor deceased. Chip intact. Do not wake.'

rooms.name: Generator raft
rooms.text: A ship's engine bolted to a raft, feeding half the archipelago. The people tending it are deaf, or have stopped listening.

rooms.name: Throne steps
rooms.text: Steps built of welded junk, climbing to a chair made of other people's parts. Offerings rot at the bottom.

look.text: Offerings at the foot of the steps: teeth, chips, a wedding ring with the finger still in it.

rooms.name: The patchwork throne
rooms.text: A throne of limbs and casings, and something sitting in it that wears a crown of grafts. It has been expecting a visitor.
rooms.quiet: An empty throne of limbs and casings, the crown gone from it. The grafts still twitch when you pass.
